generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A globally green CI run can coexist with stale remote job identity or a requirement-to-test mapping that points at a different passing test, allowing an evidence packet to overclaim control coverage.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Persist the first convenient green job and reuse any passing neighboring test as proof for a structurally different requirement without resolving the job or inspecting the cited test source.
trigger_signals: run and job identifiers are persisted
distinct controls are covered by multiple test files

reusable_control.description: Require exact requirement-to-control-to-test-to-job traceability with independently resolved remote identity and reached/passed evidence.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Before handoff, validate that every CI-backed control references the exact immutable test that exercises its discriminant scenario and an independently resolvable remote job on the material head.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: During audit, resolve the claimed remote job, confirm reached/passed state from raw evidence, inspect the cited immutable test source, and compare control IDs against the attack matrix.

transfer_cases.scenario: A manifest references a positive numeric job identifier that does not resolve in the claimed run.
transfer_cases.evidence: prevention validator rejects unresolved remote job identity

transfer_cases.scenario: A requirement references a passing test while its negative control identifier differs from the attack matrix.
transfer_cases.evidence: prevention validator rejects mismatched control-to-test mapping
